title: THE DIPLOMA STILL HAS TO BE EARNED
note: A 120-second causal chain. DRAFT and IF ADOPTED remain load-bearing in voice and picture.

lines.text: An automatic press targets a U A diploma. One question stops it. Who earned this?
lines.t: An automatic press targets a U A diploma. One question stops it. Who earned this?

lines.text: AI Engaged is a draft the Board discusses today.
lines.t: AI Engaged is a draft the Board discusses today.

lines.text: It proposes six principles, four priorities from classrooms to Arctic research, and five expectations including literacy, security, and oversight.
lines.t: It proposes six principles, four priorities from classrooms to Arctic research, and five expectations including literacy, security, and oversight.

lines.text: But tools should deepen learning, not replace the effort that builds competence.
lines.t: But tools should deepen learning, not replace the effort that builds competence.

lines.text: So a U A credential would certify what the student earned.
lines.t: So a U A credential would certify what the student earned.

lines.text: And one framework would not mean one classroom rule.
lines.t: And one framework would not mean one classroom rule.

lines.text: U A A, U A F, and U A S keep curriculum judgment. Faculty choose AI by course.
lines.t: U A A, U A F, and U A S keep curriculum judgment. Faculty choose AI by course.

lines.text: A coordinating council would share tools and training.
lines.t: A coordinating council would share tools and training.

lines.text: Then the diploma flips into a second trust test.
lines.t: Then the diploma flips into a second trust test.

lines.text: The draft addresses predictive AI affecting student progress or business operations.
lines.t: The draft addresses predictive AI affecting student progress or business operations.

lines.text: Examples include admissions, financial aid, advising, and H R analytics.
lines.t: Examples include admissions, financial aid, advising, and H R analytics.

lines.text: Those uses would need documented evaluation and meaningful human oversight.
lines.t: Those uses would need documented evaluation and meaningful human oversight.

lines.text: Strong words. But meaningful and earned are not measurements.
lines.t: Strong words. But meaningful and earned are not measurements.

lines.text: It defines neither, nor a reviewer's power.
lines.t: It defines neither, nor a reviewer's power.

lines.text: So the plan must survive its own test.
lines.t: So the plan must survive its own test.

lines.text: A twelve-month clock waits behind glass.
lines.t: A twelve-month clock waits behind glass.

lines.text: Still a draft. Clock stopped. Separate budget.
lines.t: Still a draft. Clock stopped. Separate budget.

lines.text: If adopted, institutions get one year to build policies and plans.
lines.t: If adopted, institutions get one year to build policies and plans.

lines.text: Then Alaska gets evidence. Did AI deepen learning? Did oversight matter? Does the diploma still mean what it says?
lines.t: Then Alaska gets evidence. Did AI deepen learning? Did oversight matter? Does the diploma still mean what it says?

lines.text: The machine can help. A human pulls the press.
lines.t: The machine can help. A human pulls the press.
